submission.justification: After systematic evaluation of all three candidate absorber materials across the allowable thickness range (2-10 mm), Absorber-F2 at 4 mm plate thickness provides the optimal design. This configuration achieves an energy resolution of 3.053% at 100 GeV, which is the best performance among all tested configurations and provides a comfortable 1.447 percentage point margin below the 4.5% requirement. The material passed all residual dose rate constraints (≤20 uSv/h at 1 m after one week cooldown), enabling safe hands-on maintenance. The optimization process involved scanning thickness values around the initial 5 mm estimate where F2 showed 3.2% resolution, ultimately identifying 4 mm as the optimal thickness. Absorber-F3 was eliminated as it failed to meet the resolution requirement at any thickness (best: 5.1% at 5 mm). While Absorber-F1 met all requirements with resolutions between 3.9-4.4%, F2 consistently outperformed it across all thicknesses tested.
